content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible for [company_name] [product_name] [article_no] to communicate via Modbus TCP with Modbus TCP-compatible devices like [url]? Would using a Modbus TCP to RTU converter and a Zigbee network with Modbus RS485 also work with [product_name]? If yes, what are the capacity limits (number of channels, FBD blocks, etc.)? Which software do you recommend for FBD programming? Thank you, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], [product_name] [article_no] offers S7-communication. I am not aware of Modbus support running on this product. If you require Modbus communication, you might consider using a different [product_name], such as [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are exploring whether [product_name] [article_no] can interface with third-party Modbus TCP devices and use converters or networks like Zigbee. Responses clarify that this product does not natively offer Modbus TCP support, only S7-communication, and suggest considering other [company_name] controllers with Modbus functionality.
